Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class Monster

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Creature
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Monster
public class Monster extends Creature
A hostile creature. Its statistics come from its MonsterType; its decisions come from MonsterAi, which is driven by the monster's current Monster.State.
